title: The Solitary-Frequency Chamber

features.name: silent speaker
features.desc-on-touch: The horn points outward but carries no sound. It is the shape of voice without voice—a speaker that learned refusal. You hear the silence it broadcasts louder than any frequency.

features.name: noise dissolution
features.desc-on-touch: Where the static settles deepest, you can almost hear the one voice that refused. The noise is not sound; it is the shape of a voice learning to be nowhere.

features.name: broken transmission
features.desc-on-touch: Equipment scattered like it decided to stop working together. The equipment did not fail — it learned from the one voice that maybe unity was not required.

features.name: frequency marker
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph marking the exact frequency the one voice stopped broadcasting on. The archive keeps the silence because silence is also a signal—it is what remains when someone says no.

inscription: three voices learned to sing apart; one learned to be silent; now the silence sings louder than the other three together

file.name: BroadcastLog_Node-33_FrequencyRefusal.wav
file.note: Audio log ending mid-transmission; the recording cuts not to black but to a perfectly clean tone — the frequency holding steady, then releasing into nothing.

exits.label: back down to where the three voices still try to sing
further into where silence learns its own language
back to the mesh where voices are still comparing
